symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set $[h]$.
symbols.quote: A *triple* is a three-element subset of $[h]$; $\mathfrak a$ and $\mathfrak b$ denote triples.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A second three-element subset of the ground set $[h]$.
symbols.quote: A *triple* is a three-element subset of $[h]$; $\mathfrak a$ and $\mathfrak b$ denote triples.

symbols.name: indicator vector
symbols.meaning: The 0-1 vector of triple $\mathfrak a$, with entry 1 at each position in $\mathfrak a$ and entry 0 elsewhere.
symbols.quote: The indicator vector $t_{\mathfrak a}$ has entry $1$ at each position $p \in \mathfrak a$, where $p$ is an element of $[h]$, and entry $0$ elsewhere.

symbols.name: position
symbols.meaning: An element of the ground set $[h]$, indexing one entry of an indicator vector.
symbols.quote: The indicator vector $t_{\mathfrak a}$ has entry $1$ at each position $p \in \mathfrak a$, where $p$ is an element of $[h]$, and entry $0$ elsewhere.

symbols.name: all-ones matrix
symbols.meaning: The $h\times h$ matrix whose entries are all 1.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathbf 1\mathbf 1^{\top}$ denote the $h\times h$ all-ones matrix.

relations.quote: An indicator vector is the 0-1 vector that marks which elements of a [Ground set](ground-set.md) belong to a given subset.
Indicator vectors are tested for orthogonality by the [bilinear form](bilinear-form.md) of each construction.
